292a2165ca76645d.description: About Maaden Maaden, established in 1997, is recognized as one of the fastest-growing mining companies globally and the largest multi-commodity mining and metals company in the Middle East. The company is instrumental in developing the mining industry to become a key pillar of Saudi Arabia’s economy by building an integrated mining value chain. Role Overview The Principal Specialist, Data Modeling & Arch (Operational Technology) will establish the data modeling and architecture foundation for Operational Technology (OT) and industrial data across plants, sites, and operational systems. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, is crucial for enabling trusted OT analytics by standardizing data representation, governance, and alignment with enterprise IT data products for assets, tags, events, alarms, measurements, production contexts, historians, SCADA/DCS, and condition monitoring data. Key Responsibilities Define enterprise OT data modeling standards for time-series data, events, alarms, assets, tags, measurements, and production contexts. Establish canonical OT concepts including asset hierarchy, location hierarchy, tag naming, measurement definitions, and work order linkage. Design scalable data schemas for curated OT layers and reusable OT data products with auditability, lineage, and quality attributes. Architect OT-to-IT data alignment patterns that connect operational measurements with enterprise entities for reporting and analytics. Define integration rules for tag mapping, unit standardization, reference data, semantic consistency, and cross-site normalization. Embed governance-by-design into OT data models, including ownership, metadata, lineage, quality rules, and lifecycle controls. Partner with OT engineering, cybersecurity, data platform, and infrastructure teams to design secure and compliant OT data flows. Review solution designs, data models, vendor deliverables, and integration approaches to ensure architectural consistency. Provide technical leadership on OT semantics, industrial data architecture, data modeling practices, and data product design. Coach engineers, data modelers, platform teams, and solution teams on OT modeling standards and implementation practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in data modeling and architecture, specifically within Operational Technology environments. Demonstrated ability to address high-volume industrial data, latency requirements, site variability, and intermittent connectivity in modeling patterns. Experience in aligning historians, SCADA/DCS, condition monitoring, maintenance, reliability, and production data with enterprise data products. Proficiency in defining quality attributes for historian data, including compression, interpolation, quality flags, sampling frequency, and streaming patterns. Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity requirements, segmentation, access control, and operational resilience. Measures of Success Success in this role will be demonstrated by the consistent adoption of standard OT data models across sites, platforms, and industrial systems. This includes the consistent representation of assets, tags, events, alarms, measurements, and production contexts for trusted analytics. Effective OT-to-IT integration patterns that enable reliable cross-domain reporting, performance analysis, and data product development are also key indicators. Additionally, the role's success will be measured by curated OT layers that feature clear lineage, quality rules, auditability, and governance controls, alongside accelerated site onboarding, tag normalization, unit standardization, and data model reuse through practical reference patterns.

ENGINEER - PLANNING will be responsible for leading planning activities, including schedule preparation, progress monitoring, and delay analysis. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and involves both headquarters (HQ) and project-based responsibilities, ensuring alignment with project scope and strategy. Key Responsibilities Lead the preparation of comprehensive, resource-loaded, and cost-loaded schedules, specifically Tender Schedules (HQ role) or Project Baseline Schedules (Project role), ensuring full alignment with project scope and strategy. Prepare and deliver tailored Tranquil ERP demonstrations, including setting up demo environments with realistic data for contracting, trading, or manufacturing industries. Provide comprehensive training and support to clients, including knowledge transfer on minor technical details. Ensure successful system go-live upon project completion. Ensure projects are closed within their deadlines. Maintain ongoing communication with customers to address queries or concerns. Report the status of pre-sales opportunities and ongoing implementations to management. Experience and Qualifications 2-5 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to bridge communication between sales, technical teams, and clients. Experience with ERP software pre-sales and implementation processes. 29c9d4455cd0f65c.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة اول و تالي التجارية عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة التسجيلات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. نظرة عامة على الدور يتولى موظف الصندوق مسؤولية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود، واستلام المدفوعات بمختلف الطرق، وتحديث قوائم الأسعار. كما يشمل الدور تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والتعامل مع طلبات العملاء المتعلقة بقوائم الشراء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، والتأكد من توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني ومرحب، وتلبية رغباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق شركة اول و تالي التجارية في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والتركيز في التعاملات المالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

29ddbf104c5981cc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية وضمان سير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. الهدف العام للوظيفة يشارك المدير الإداري في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، ويشرف على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإدارية بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة. كما يتابع كافة العمليات الإدارية ذات الصلة، ويضمن توفر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لضمان سير العمليات اليومية بأقصى كفاءة وفعالية ممكنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. التأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لمعرفة مستوى تحقيق الخطط والأهداف الإدارية. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة ومراجعتها باستمرار لتحسينها وضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المختلفة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة وتنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية المتبعة، وضمان إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بكافة القرارات والتعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على عمليات إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة في الشؤون الإدارية وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتهم بالتحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف وتنفيذ الخطط. مهارات إشرافية وتنظيمية قوية. بيئة العمل يعمل المدير الإداري بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق أعلى مستويات الكفاءة في العمليات الإدارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

29ffd3a736431a55.description: About Lucid Motors Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating mobility experiences through innovation. The company develops award-winning vehicles based on proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture. Lucid operates with deep vertical integration, handling design, engineering, and production in-house across its global offices and manufacturing facilities. Teams at Lucid are united by a commitment to excellence, aiming to redefine possibilities in mobility. The Role of Sr. Engineer, Closures Mechanisms/Plastics - Doors The Sr. Engineer, Closures Mechanisms/Plastics - Doors is responsible for ensuring the design intent assembly requirements of closure mechanisms and plastics on the manufacturing line. This full-time role serves as the technical lead for product issue root cause analysis and deviation containment, supporting product launches as the primary engineering contact for Mechanisms/Plastics. The position also involves sustaining engineering post-launch, including the design and release of new parts to enhance quality or assembly processes. The Sr. Engineer will collaborate with core engineering to ensure parts meet all design and validation requirements. Key Responsibilities Assume ownership of Closures Mechanisms and plastic system assembly. Solve complex component/system level problems using standard problem-solving techniques to determine root cause and provide containment solutions. Ensure design intent assembly requirements for closure systems are enforced on the assembly line. Implement data-driven proactive problem-solving and issue avoidance strategies for process deviations or critical part quality issues. Support new product launches and execute part concession deviations for Closures Mechanisms/Plastics components within the manufacturing plant. Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure efficient process sequencing and build quality. costing model, stock movements and transaction logic — ensuring at all times that the ERP reflects how the business actually operates rather than the reverse. ▪ Keep the ERP aligned with the evolution of the business: assess the impact of new products, processes, divisions, plants or commercial models on the system's design, and lead the corresponding configuration or development changes in a controlled and documented manner. ▪ Translate business requirements into functional specifications for the IT Analyst and external providers, validate the resulting solutions before deployment, and ensure user training and adoption. ▪ Own master data governance, process mapping, user discipline and the integrity of the data used for management reporting, guaranteeing a single, reliable source of information for decision-making. ▪ Drive digitalisation of shop-floor data capture, production reporting and management dashboards, reducing manual consolidation and reporting lead times. ▪ Manage IT budgets, service providers, licensing and service levels. 2.3 Supply Chain ▪ Ensure continuity of supply of raw materials, consumables, spare parts and services at competitive total cost, in coordination with Procurement and Production Planning. ▪ Establish and monitor supplier performance in delivery, lead time, documentation and technical compliance, escalating deviations with supporting evidence. ▪ Oversee logistics, imports and customs coordination, ensuring compliance with local regulations and correct documentation flow. ▪ Support the sales and operations planning cycle, aligning demand forecasts, production capacity and material availability. 2.4 Inventory Management ▪ Own inventory accuracy across all locations, implementing cycle counting, reconciliation procedures and clear accountability for stock movements. ▪ Define and maintain stock policies: minimum and maximum levels, reorder points, safety stock and coverage targets by material category. ▪ Control slow-moving, obsolete and non-conforming stock, proposing disposal, reprocessing or re-use routes. ▪ Work side by side with the Cost Controlling Department, ensuring full consistency between physical stock records, standard and actual costs, consumption variances and month-end valuation; jointly investigate and explain any deviation. ▪ Ensure rigorous metal balance reconciliation between physical inventory, production records and financial records. ▪ Optimise working capital tied up in inventory without compromising service levels to production and customers. 2.5 Investment Projects ▪ Act as the single point of centralisation for the Company's investment projects, maintaining a consolidated portfolio with scope, status, budget, schedule and expected returns. ▪ Standardise the investment process: preparation of investment requests, technical specification, supplier and technology benchmarking, quotation comparison and risk assessment. ▪ Build the economic evaluation of each project — CAPEX, operating cost impact, payback, IRR and sensitivity analysis — in cooperation with Cost Controlling and Finance, and present it to the Investment Committee in decision-ready format. ▪ Coordinate project execution across engineering, production, maintenance, supply chain, IT and external contractors, ensuring milestones, budget and safety requirements are met. ▪ Manage commissioning, ramp-up and hand-over to operations, followed by post-investment review comparing actual performance against the approved business case. 2.6 Coordination with the Systems Department — Environment, Health & Safety ▪ Coordinate with the Systems Department to ensure that environmental and safety requirements are embedded in process design, materials selection, IT systems and supply chain practices. ▪ Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Company's certified management systems (quality, environment, occupational health and safety, energy) within the scope of the areas under this position. ▪ Ensure that technical and improvement projects incorporate environmental compliance, emissions, waste and safety considerations from the design stage. 3. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL MANDATE ▪ Structure the Company's priority initiatives as defined projects — objectives, scope, resources, milestones, owners and measurable results — and lead them personally, mobilising the different areas involved without duplicating their line responsibilities. ▪ Act as a neutral facilitator between the operational, technical and commercial departments of Metals and its counterparts within the Electric Group, resolving interface issues before they escalate into operational or client-facing problems. ▪ Chair or coordinate cross-departmental review meetings on matters involving more than one division, ensuring that agreed actions have owners, deadlines and verified closure. ▪ Prepare consolidated, fact-based analyses and recommendations for Executive Management, including options, risks, quantified impact and implementation requirement
